articles.summary: Discover how Kodiak AI uses Vision-Language Models to enhance the safety and decision-making of autonomous trucks, using human-like AI to navigate complex scenarios.
articles.title: LLMs Take the Wheel: How Generative AI Can Improve Autonomous Safety

articles.summary: Textron Systems and Kodiak AI have integrated the Kodiak Driver into the RIPSAW M3, creating a rugged, autonomous, uncrewed military ground vehicle. This collaboration aims to enhance military automation and explore future opportunities with the U.S. Department of Defense and allied nations.
articles.title: Kodiak and Textron Systems Unveil Autonomous RIPSAW M3
